normalized_work_text.description: Lowercase work description with punctuation removed and whitespace collapsed.
normalized_work_text.transformation: Text cleaning regex and space collapsing.

work_text_length.description: Character count of the raw work description.

work_word_count.description: Word count of the cleaned work description.

work_unique_word_count.description: Unique word count of the cleaned work description.

work_type.description: Primary convenience category mapping of the work description.
work_type.transformation: Regex keyword matching with defined priorities: water > road > building > drainage > electrical > school > health > repair.
work_type.limitations: Heuristic-based convenience category; might map to 'other' if no keywords are matched.

work_has_road_keyword.description: True if work description contains matching keywords for 'road'.
work_has_road_keyword.transformation: Case-insensitive regex matching for keywords related to 'road'.
work_has_road_keyword.limitations: Dependent on the predefined keyword dictionary.

work_has_building_keyword.description: True if work description contains matching keywords for 'building'.
work_has_building_keyword.transformation: Case-insensitive regex matching for keywords related to 'building'.
work_has_building_keyword.limitations: Dependent on the predefined keyword dictionary.

allocation_amount_log.description: Natural log transform of the allocation amount (log1p).

allocation_amount_percentile_global.description: Percentile rank of the allocation amount across the entire dataset.
allocation_amount_percentile_global.limitations: Highly dependent on the distribution of current sample.

peer_state_count.description: Total count of records sharing the same state.

peer_state_median_amount.description: Median allocation amount for the peer group sharing the same state.
peer_state_median_amount.transformation: Group median. Set to NaN if group size < 5.
peer_state_median_amount.limitations: Descriptive statistic of current dataset. Suppressed for small groups.

peer_state_mean_amount.description: Mean allocation amount for the peer group sharing the same state.
peer_state_mean_amount.transformation: Group mean. Set to NaN if group size < 5.
peer_state_mean_amount.limitations: Descriptive statistic of current dataset. Suppressed for small groups.

peer_state_std_amount.description: Standard deviation of allocation amount for the peer group sharing the same state.
peer_state_std_amount.transformation: Group standard deviation. Set to NaN if group size < 5.
peer_state_std_amount.limitations: Descriptive statistic of current dataset. Suppressed for small groups.

amount_vs_peer_state_median.description: Ratio of the record's allocation amount vs the peer median of group state.
amount_vs_peer_state_median.transformation: allocation_amount / peer_state_median_amount. Set to NaN if group size < 5.
amount_vs_peer_state_median.limitations: Descriptive comparison only. Suppressed for small groups.

amount_zscore_peer_state.description: Z-score of the allocation amount within peer group state.
amount_zscore_peer_state.transformation: (amount - mean) / std. Set to NaN if group size < 5 or std is undefined/NaN.
amount_zscore_peer_state.limitations: Descriptive comparison only. Suppressed for small groups. Zero standard deviation maps to 0.0.

recommendation_day_of_week.description: Day of the week (0=Monday to 6=Sunday) extracted from recommended_date.

recommendation_day_of_month.description: Day of the month (1-31) extracted from recommended_date.

mp_recommendations_in_month.description: Count of recommendations made by the same MP in that calendar month.
mp_recommendations_in_month.transformation: Group count by MP and Year-Month.
mp_recommendations_in_month.limitations: Descriptive calendar-month aggregate. Boundary effects apply at month start/end.

constituency_recommendations_in_month.description: Count of recommendations made in the same constituency in that calendar month.
constituency_recommendations_in_month.transformation: Group count by constituency and Year-Month.
constituency_recommendations_in_month.limitations: Descriptive calendar-month aggregate. Boundary effects apply.

mp_recommendations_rolling_30d.description: Rolling count of recommendations made by the same MP in the last 30 days.
mp_recommendations_rolling_30d.transformation: Chronomax rolling window count [T-30d, T] up to current record. Leakage-free.
mp_recommendations_rolling_30d.limitations: Requires sorted historical alignment. Sensitive to date correctness.

constituency_recommendations_rolling_30d.description: Rolling count of recommendations made in the same constituency in the last 30 days.
constituency_recommendations_rolling_30d.transformation: Chronomax rolling window count [T-30d, T] up to current record. Leakage-free.

location_completeness_score.description: Fraction of location columns containing valid values.
location_completeness_score.limitations: Assumes equal weight for all location dimensions.

location_key.limitations: Empty fields are left blank within the separators.

mp_work_count.description: Total count of works recommended by this MP in the current dataset.
mp_work_count.limitations: Descriptive feature of the current sample.

constituency_work_count.description: Total count of works recommended in this constituency in the current dataset.
constituency_work_count.limitations: Descriptive feature of the current sample.

state_work_count.description: Total count of works recommended in this state in the current dataset.
state_work_count.limitations: Descriptive feature of the current sample.

ida_work_count.description: Total count of works assigned to this IDA in the current dataset.
ida_work_count.limitations: Descriptive feature of the current sample.

is_exact_duplicate.description: True if duplicate_occurrence_count is greater than 1.

blocking_key_work_type_state.description: Candidate key combining work_type and state for near-duplicate candidate blocking.
blocking_key_work_type_state.transformation: Concatenation of work_type and state in lowercase.

blocking_key_work_type_constituency.description: Candidate key combining work_type and constituency for near-duplicate candidate blocking.
blocking_key_work_type_constituency.transformation: Concatenation of work_type and constituency in lowercase.
